name: @nexus/execution-adapter
description: Phase 11A-2 Execution Adapter Foundation — pure, deterministic, fail-closed translation layer between runtime services and the sealed @nexus/execution-core. Ships a PaperExecutionAdapter (deterministic, injected-fill-only, no market simulation, no auto-profit) and a NullExecutionAdapter (always fail-closed). ZERO broker/exchange/IO; clock-injected, randomness-forbidden, replay-safe. Contains NO trading logic — entries, R:R, targets, confidence, readiness and sizing are ALL owned by the sealed core and consumed VERBATIM.
